in_marathi.name: Durvisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Difficulty, obstacle, challenge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durvisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Durvisha is derived from the Sanskrit root 'dur' meaning 'difficulty, obstacle, challenge' and the suffix 'visha' meaning 'poison'. In Hindu mythology, Durvasha was the name of a sage who cursed King Janaka, leading to the birth of Sita, the wife of Lord Rama. The name symbolizes the idea of overcoming obstacles with wisdom and courage.
